distribution: Derived transport of the 2026-10-01 delivery; scientific files are byte-identical to selected original records.
reason_for_exclusion: Volatile macOS Finder metadata; no replacement bytes are invented and the original manifest is unchanged.
complete_release_zip: Retains all 29,013 other original records and the original manifest, including files under all nine .git directories.
browsable_view: Retains the same bytes and paths except files with an exact .git path component; those files remain in the complete Release ZIP. .lake, .gitignore and other selected files are retained.

original_source_manifest_comparison.method: Read-only standard-library comparison; the original verifier was not executed by this constructor.
original_source_manifest_comparison.caveat: The original manifest includes a Finder .DS_Store record. That single record is excluded from this derivative and is not repaired or removed from the original manifest. PASS_TRANSPORT_CONTENT does not mean PASS_FILE_INTEGRITY for the original delivery.

scope: Integrity of the derived transport only: retained original-manifest files and the unchanged original manifest. No mathematical validation, new scientific computation, Lean compilation or native Windows execution.
